title: SDLC ledger
description: The per-feature agent-SDLC ledger (chorus-sdlc § The ledger): append-only, one gate section per gate execution, enough to reconstruct the run alone. Operator rulings appear only as ruling_ref.

schema_version.description: Schema version; the major must be 1.

mode.description: agent-sdlc: the lifecycle. challenge: chorus challenge (premise pass standalone).

gates.description: Gate executions in order; a re-run appends a new cycle, never edits a prior one.

gate.description: Gate A (design), B (plan/tasks), C (implementation), or a standalone challenge.

rsvp.description: This gate's RSVP (never carried from another gate, S2).

band.description: 🟢 strict sort or J ≤ 5; 🟡 tie at the cap → default panel.

decision_ref.description: 🟡 only: id of the seating DecisionRecord in decisions.

premise_pass.description: Gate A and challenge only: the premise pass, recorded before the within-frame findings.

red_team.description: The fixed RT-1..RT-6 checklist, each outcome recorded every pass.

outcome.description: What the pass found for this item.

honest_null.description: The honest-null: when the premise survives, what was tried.

premise_survives.description: Whether the premise survived the pass.

tried.description: Each attack attempted: a lens and one of the four attack forms.

note.description: What was tried and why it did not land.

pass_ok.description: false: the pass did not genuinely attack the premise — a failed pass, re-run.

register.description: Findings register; scope and parked mark premise, within-frame and parked-from-premise findings.

tally.description: Vote tally: one row per register entry that is not [unsupported].

red_resolutions.description: 🔴 resolution/waiver log: every gating 🔴 gets a row before the run can be complete (S4).

disposition.description: resolved (incorporation, verified by re-run), waived (operator only), or still open.

detail.description: How it was resolved, or where the waiver rationale lives.

ruling_ref.description: The operator's waiver ruling. Required when waived.

unclaimed_records.description: Fixed-viewpoint records no persona authored into a finding: visible, non-gating.

result.description: pass: proceed. halt: awaiting operator. bound-reached: the third cycle left a 🔴 uncleared; it goes to the operator as a hard-block (S7). self-heal: 🟡 auto-incorporate and re-run. aborted: quorum failed.

awaiting.description: halt/bound-reached: the findings waiting on the operator.

decisions.description: Provisional decisions (review & override) and every other DecisionRecord of the run.

memory_update.description: Memory update (sign-off): once per lifecycle, after Gate C clears.

written.description: Records written to its own memory.

noop.description: Which test produced a no-op, when written is 0.

project_wide_diff.description: The proposed addendum diff, or its locator.

operator.description: The operator's answer to the project-wide proposal.

pending.description: Pending proposals, re-offered at the next sign-off.

secret_filter.description: Whether the secret pre-filter ran over the sign-off writes, and its drops.

self_audit.description: End-of-run S1–S11 self-audit: each item with a pointer to its evidence.

evidence.description: Pointer to the evidence row, e.g. 'gates[1].tally'.

rulings_cited.description: Standing operator rulings the run relied on.

local_rulings.description: Fallback only, when no ruling sink is bound: rulings held in this record, cited as record '#'.
